Bluespec Compiler, version 2025.07 (build 282e82e9)
This is free software; for source code and copying conditions, see
https://github.com/B-Lang-org/bsc

Invoking command line:
bsc -v

scope: Generated-Verilog kernel simulation; not a shared hardware implementation
adder_capture_semantics: Request and result capture share one clock edge; actual sumR or sumQ storage is checked before the next rising edge

control.timing_scope: kernel interface cycles; excludes UART, physical timing and post-completion drain

observed.timing_scope: kernel interface cycles; excludes UART, physical timing and post-completion drain

recovery.reason: The generated fast.gch file was incomplete and GCC rejected it as an invalid PCH.
recovery.action: Removed only the generated fast.gch and rebuilt the existing observed object directory with make -j1.
